face.name: 鲜血医师萨安娜
face.text: 战吼：&获得一项消耗残骸的第二英雄技能。
face.flavorText: 鲜血公主萨安娜被关得太久了，连大法师们都记不清到底有多久。她化作了监狱中的医官，并不只是为了满足对血的渴望。在萨安娜的实验室里，锁着她可怕的创造……

face.name: Blood Doctor Thal'ena
face.text: Battlecry:& Get a second Hero Power that costs Corpses.
face.flavorText: Blood-Princess Thal’ena has been imprisoned for longer than the archmages can remember. Posing as the prison’s doctor, Thal’ena is not content to sate her hunger. Locked in her lab, she is creating something terrifying…

face.name: 锈烂蝰蛇
face.text: 可交易。战吼：&摧毁对手的武器。
face.flavorText: 这也是剧毒，针对武器的剧毒。

face.name: 始生幼龙
face.text: 嘲讽。战吼：&对所有其他随从造成2点伤害。
face.flavorText: 它的一副公鸭嗓让自己在族群里独树一帜。

face.name: Primordial Drake
face.text: Taunt Battlecry:& Deal 2 damage to all other minions.
face.flavorText: Before he became a rap artist.

face.name: F3TCH3R寻回机
face.text: 战吼：拼装一张法力值消耗为（4）的随从牌。

face.name: 流沙塑型者
face.text: 战吼：拼装一张具有回合结束时效果的随从牌。
face.flavorText: 这次修筑还需要沙子。去沙漠的坐标是多少来着？

face.name: Sandcrafter
face.text: Battlecry: Assemble a minion with an end of your turn effect.
face.flavorText: We need more sand for this build. What are the cords to the desert again?

face.name: 凯恩·血蹄
face.text: 嘲讽。亡语：&召唤一个5/5的贝恩·血蹄。
face.flavorText: 凯恩被加尔鲁什杀害了，所以...别把这张牌放在战士的套牌里，这完全说不通。

face.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
face.flavorText: Cairne was killed by Garrosh, so... don't put this guy in a Warrior deck. It's pretty insensitive.

face.name: 蒸汽清洁器
face.text: 战吼：摧毁双方玩家牌库中所有套牌之外的牌。
face.flavorText: 自从心能短缺，工作清闲了下来。地上迸溅的心能少多了！

face.name: Steamcleaner
face.text: Battlecry: Destroy ALL cards in both players' decks that didn't start there.
face.flavorText: Business is slow since the anima shortage began. Things just don't get stained like they used to!
